name: college-adda
description: College Adda — deadlines, section timetables, attendance, code desks, a 2D campus, people and events. Built for JECRC Jaipur.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @adda/server" "npm run dev -w @adda/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @adda/server && npm run typecheck -w @adda/client
